Commentary.Commentary: The pitch appears to be a batting-friendly one! The Protea batsmen enjoyed the early conditions against the new ball and England would like to do the same when they come out to chase. Powerplay is going to be crucial for both sides as it will set the tone. The home team looks 20-25 runs short and let's see how they strategize their defense. Don't forget, Dale Steyn will be in action. Do join us in a short while.

Innings of two halves - 105/1 in the first 10 and 72/7 in the next 10!! South Africa dominated the initial play courtesy scintillating batting from Quinton de Kock and Temba Bavuma and the next phase belonged to the English comeback. Going by the way their bowlers fared, it seems that the pacers are not enjoying much bowling on this deck. In stark contrast, Moeen Ali and Adil Rashid revelled the conditions and were by far the best bowlers on show. Although, England's seamers did a fair job at the death to restrict the South African charge. Just 8 runs came off the last two overs.

OUT! RUN OUT! Brilliant bowling from Jordan to end the innings. Very full delivery on middle, almost a yorker. Phehlukwayo can only push it back to the bowler. Steyn takes off for the single. Andile though is late in taking off but even if he did so, it would have been almost impossible for him to make the crease at the non-striker's end. Jordan collects the ball and then runs behind to whip the bails off at his end. Phehlukwayo is nowhere in the picture. Only 5 runs from the last over. SOUTH AFRICA END ON 177/8.
Very well bowled! Very full delivery on middle, Phehlukwayo drives it back to the bowler.
Good length ball on off, Steyn drives it to the cover region for a single.
FOUR! A boundary off the Hat Trick ball! Slower delivery down the leg side, Steyn flicks it to the fine leg region for a boundary.
Chris Jordan is on a hat-trick and it will be Dale Steyn who will face it.

OUT! TIMBER! This is top class bowling from Jordan. A ripper of a yorker from Chris and it fetches him another wicket. It is bowled around middle and off, with some reverse swing on it. Hendricks looks to flick but fails. The ball hits the stumps and Hendricks has to go.
Beuran Hendricks is the new man in.

OUT! TIMBER! You miss, I hit stuff from Jordan. He is excellent at the death and proves it yet again. Full delivery on off, Pretorius looks to lift it over long on but misses and the ball goes on to uproot the off stump. Excellent stuff.
He does end on a high. Just three runs and a wicket from his third and final over. Good length ball on off, Pretorius pushes it to the point region for a single. Very good comeback from Wood.
Short delivery on off, Andile pushes it to the cover region for a single.
Dwaine Pretorius is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Stokes is not going to drop those. Wonderful stuff from Wood. Low full tosses are usually difficult to hit and this is another one of those occasions. Wood bowls this on middle, Smuts looks to flick but it takes the leading edge and goes towards mid off. Stokes runs ahead and takes a simple catch. England are having a brilliant last few overs.
Low full toss on off, Phehlukwayo misses out as he drives it to deep cover for a single.
Slower short ball outside off, Phehlukwayo is early into his pull and fails to make connection.
BEATEN! Excellent start to the over from Wood! A yorker outside off, Phehlukwayo looks to drive but fails to get any bat on it.
Mark Wood to bowl the penultimate over of the innings. He has not had a good evening so far. 29 is what he has gone for in his 2 overs. Can he end on a high?
Full delivery on middle, Andile clears his front leg and then looks to drive it to the off side. The ball takes the inside half of the bat and goes towards long on for a single.
This is terrific bowling from Jordan! Yorker on the pads, Phehlukwayo looks to dig it out but fails to get any bat on it.
SIX! That has gone a long way! Slower short ball down the leg side, Andile waits for it and pulls it in front of the square leg region for a biggie.
Very full delivery around off, Smuts digs it out to the cover region for a single.
Well bowled from Jordan! Sees the batsman making room and bowls it on a length outside off, Smuts cannot do anything but leave the ball alone. Maybe, he thought it will be wided.
Jordan tries to bowl a yorker but it ends up as a low full toss. Phehlukwayo makes room and looks to drive but mistimes it to wide mid off. A single taken.
Chris Jordan is back on. 1-0-14-1 so far from him.

No it does not! Very good bowling from Stokes. Good length ball outside off, he takes pace off this one. Phehlukwayo looks to play the ramp shot moving across the stumps. He fails to connect and the ball goes to the leg side off his pad for a leg bye. A dozen off the over.
Free Hit coming up!
NO BALL! Ben Stokes oversteps. Good length ball outside off, Phehlukwayo throws his bat at it but misses. Will the Free Hit cost Stokes?
On the pads, Smuts flicks it to the leg side for one.
Very good running from this pair. Good length ball on middle and leg, Smuts places it towards cow corner and runs the first one hard. He wants two and he gets it.
FOUR! Good shot! Length ball on the body, Smuts pulls it through the vacant deep square leg region for a boundary.
Length ball outside off, Andile punches it to the off side and gets a single.
WIDE! Stokes goes wide outside off, too wide of the tramline. Phehlukwayo looks to cut but misses. Wided by the umpire. 150 up for South Africa with this.
Good length ball away from the leg pole. Smuts backs away and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. The batsmen have run through for a single. 13 from the over in spite of a big wicket of David Miller in it.
FOUR! Hammered! Short ball on middle, Smuts pulls it to the deep mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Short ball on middle, Andile pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
SIX! What a way to get your innings underway! Absolutely brilliant. Full on middle, Phehlukwayo makes room and lifts it over the long off region for a maximum.
Slower delivery outside off, Smuts guides it to third man for a single.
Andile Phehlukwayo is the new batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Excellent catch from Jordan. These kind of catches are not easy to take but Jordan has made it look very easy. Slower length ball on off, Miller looks to lift it over mid off but it takes the top half of the bat. Jordan runs back from mid off and takes a very good catch. South Africa struggling to get going after a stupendous start!
Tom Curran is back on. 2-0-28-0 are his figures.
Yes, he can! Just 7 off the over from Stokes. He has been superb with the ball in his two overs. Length ball on off, Miller punches it to long off and keeps the strike.
Pulled with power but there is protection in the deep. Good over so far from big Ben. Just 5 singles and a wide so far. Can he finish it well?
WIDE! Slower and short down the leg side. Smuts moves and looks to pull but misses. Wided by the umpire.
Stokes bangs it in short as Miller comes down the track. The southpaw manages to pull it towards mid-wicket and get to the other end.
Once again Stokes goes full around the pads, Smuts flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Full outside off, Miller milks it to long off for a run.
Fuller on off, Smuts plays it towards long on for a single.
Ben Stokes is back on. 1-0-6-1 so far from him.

Another appeal! Turned down. Rashid bowls a googly on off, spinning in. Smuts looks to push but misses. He gets hit on the pads. Rashid appeals but the umpire is not interested. England have no reviews left. Rashid finishes with 4-0-23-1. Outstanding spell by the leggie.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
Flatter one on middle, Miller works it to the deep mid-wicket region for a couple. The fielder comes across and cleans it up.

Dropped! Jason Roy has dropped a simple catch. England have been pretty poor in the field. Flighted ball on middle, Smuts comes down the track and looks to heave it away. It takes the top edge and goes towards extra cover. Roy runs back a little before settling himself. He fails to hold on and Smuts gets a golden opportunity to prove himself in the international arena.
Loopy delivery on middle, Miller drives it back to the bowler. Rashid makes a half stop and the ball goes towards mid on. The batters take a single.
FOUR! Reverse swept nicely. Floated on middle, Miller reverse sweeps it through the point region for a boundary.
Flatter one on middle, Smuts plays it back to the bowler.
Flighted one on middle, Miller comes down the track and then looks to heave it to the leg side but it takes the inside half of the bat and the ball goes towards deep mid-wicket. A single.
Shorter on middle and off, Miller punches it through covers for a couple.
Darted on the pads, Smuts flicks it with the spin towards mid-wicket for a single to get off the mark.
Tossed up on off, Miller milks it to long off for a single.
Shorter on off, Miller punches it back to the bowler.
Moeen Ali to bowl out.
Shorter one on off, Smuts punches it to point.
Flatter one on middle, Smuts works it to mid-wicket.
On middle, Smuts punches it back to the bowler.
JJ Smuts is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! This time it has been taken! Ali makes no mistake. Bavuma misses out on a fifty but it was a good innings till it lasted. Loopy one on middle, Temba looks to sweep but it goes off the top edge towards short fine leg. Moeen Ali lunges and takes the catch. England needed this wicket as the minuscule batsman was looking in great touch and taking South Africa to a good total. The visitors have a real chance of restricting the hosts here.
Flatter one on middle, Miller works it to long on for a single.

DROPPED! Tough, tough one for Denly, but it will go down as a dropped catch. Full on middle, Bavuma looks to sweep but it takes the top edge and goes towards deep square leg. Denly runs ahead and dives to catch but the ball pops out. A single taken.
Full on off, Miller drives it but straight to cover. Brilliant first over from England's go-to man in all aspects of the game. Just the 6 runs and also the big wicket of van der Dussen.
David Miller is the new man out onto the crease.

OUT! Caught! Stokes does the trick and strikes in his first over. The Nelson strikes and a very good stand between van der Dussen and Bavuma comes to an end. Effort ball from the English all-rounder. He bangs it in short on middle and leg. It is close to van der Dussen's body. He looks to pull but cannot time it well. Ends up hitting it in front of deep square leg. Bairstow there comes in and takes a simple catch.
Full on middle, it nips in a bit. Bavuma looks to flick but gets a leading edge and it goes towards point for a single.
FOUR! Gorgeous shot from Bavuma! Moves into the 40s. Full on off, Bavuma leans into the drive, gets into a beautiful position and lofts it over mid off for a boundary.
Full on middle and off, Rassie flicks it towards mid-wicket and gets a run.
Stokes starts with a full delivery on off, van der Dussen pushes it back to the bowler.
Ben Stokes for the first time today with the ball in hand.
On middle, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single. 105/1 at the halfway mark!
Two leg byes! Loopy one on the pads, van der Dussen looks to sweep but gets hit on the pads. The ball rolls to fine leg and the batters pick up a couple of leg byes. He is adamant to sweep Rashid.

NOT OUT! It is missing the leg stump. Believe us, that looked plumb to the naked eye but the Ball Tracker thinks otherwise. A loopy full toss on middle and leg, van der Dussen looks to sweep but misses to get hit flush on the pads. Rashid and the rest appeal. The umpire thinks for a while and then gives it out. Rassie discusses with his partner and they decide to take the DRS. The Ball Tracker rolls in and it shows that the ball will go on to miss the leg stump. Wonder how it decided that the ball will spin down the leg side as it hit the batsman flush on the pads.
Time for a South African review. Rassie van der Dussen has been adjudged LBW off a full toss. After a brief chat with his partner, he has signaled the 'T'.

FOUR! Very clever from van der Dussen! A leg spinner from Rashid, Rassie looks to scoop it towards fine leg but then sees the ball is around off. He adjusts well as he then scoops it towards the third man region for a boundary.
Appeal for LBW turned down! Tosses this one up on middle and off, with some spin away. Rassie looks to sweep but misses to get hit on the pads. Rashid appeals but the umpire shakes his head.
Loopy one on middle, Bavuma sweeps it to short fine leg for a single.
Full delivery on middle, Bavuma works it to long on for a single.
FOUR! This is clever! Slower delivery on middle, Bavuma scoops it over the keeper's head for a boundary.
Fullish delivery on middle, Rassie flicks it to the deep mid-wicket region for a single.
Good length ball on middle, Rassie whips it to the deep mid-wicket region for a couple.
FOUR! Misdirected slower delivery! It is bowled down the leg side, van der Dussen just helps it on its way to the fine leg region for a boundary.
WIDE! Slower delivery down the leg side, Rassie looks to flick but misses. The umpire signals it as a wide.
Good length ball on off, Rassie punches it to point for nothing.
Bowling change. Tom Curran is back for his second over. He went for 15 in his only over so far.
Tossed up on middle, Bavuma sweeps it to deep square and picks up a couple to end the over.
Looped up ball on off, Rassie drives it to long off for a single.
Full on middle, Bavuma sweeps it to short fine leg for a single.

An appeal for LBW turned down! Floated ball on the pads, Rassie looks to flick but it hits the thigh pad and rolls to short fine leg. Rashid appeals for LBW but it is turned down. The batters steal a leg bye.
Floated on middle, Bavuma sweeps it uppishly towards deep square leg. The fielder collects it on a bounce. A single.
Rashid starts with a googly on middle, van der Dussen pushes it down to long on for a single.
Adil Rashid is on now.
Fuller on off, Rassie drives it towards point for a run. Better over from Wood. 9 off this one.
Play and a miss. Good length ball outside off, van der Dussen looks to poke but misses.
Length delivery on off, Bavuma runs it down to third man for a single.

Good running! Length ball on off, Bavuma glances it towards mid-wicket and runs the first one hard. Stokes gets to the ball but the Protea pair call for two, putting pressure on Stokes. He fumbles allowing them to get two easily in the end.
FOUR! Bavuma is having fun out in the middle. Back of a length ball on off, Bavuma gets on his back foot and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Better start from Wood this time. He starts with a full ball on middle and off, Rassie flicks it wide of long on and looks for two but the fielder is quick to get there and keeps it down to one.
Mark Wood is on. He has a change of ends. 1-0-20-0 are his figures so far.
Good length ball on middle, van der Dussen works it to deep mid-wicket for a single. 68/1 after the Powerplay!
Another misfield! Full on off, van der Dussen drives it towards mid off where Ali misfields and allows the batters to take a couple.
SIX! Whacked! Good length delivery on middle, van der Dussen whips it over the deep square leg region for a maximum.

NOT OUT! It has gone straight off the bat! Wow, what a waste of a review! Good length ball on middle and off, van der Dussen defends it to cover. England though are convinced that it has gone off the pad first and they put in an appeal. The umpire shows no interest. England take the review. The replays roll in and they show that it has gone off the bat. Wonder what made England go for the review. It has to be one of the worst reviews ever.
England review for LBW against van der Dussen. They think they have their man but van der Dussen looks confident. Let's see what the replays have to say.

MISFIELD AND FOUR! What should have been a single has ended up being a boundary. Short delivery on middle, van der Dussen pulls it to deep mid-wicket. Denly comes ahead but the ball goes between his legs and into the fence.
Jordan starts with a slower ball on middle, Bavuma pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Chris Jordan is introduced into the attack.
On middle, punched down to long on for a single. End of a successful over from Ali. A wicket and 6 runs from it.
FOUR! Nicely swept away! Floated on middle, Bavuma bends on his knees and sweeps it to the deep square leg region for a boundary.
Van der Dussen is off the mark. Flatter one on middle, Rassie works it down to long on for a single.
Flatter one on middle, van der Dussen works it to mid-wicket.
Loopy on off, Rassie defends it to the off side.
Rassie van der Dussen is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Big wicket for England and it's Moeen Ali who has provided the breakthrough. Quinton de Kock will be disappointed as he was looking so good out in the middle. Ali tosses this one up on middle, de Kock looks to go big but does not time it well at all. The ball goes high towards deep mid-wicket where Joe Denly is stationed. He settles himself and pouches a simple catch. Flashy start from the skipper but he would have wanted to carry on for a longer duration. The ploy to continue with the off spinner works for Eoin Morgan.
FOUR! Whipped away nicely! Wood dishes another full one on middle, Bavuma flicks it to the deep mid-wicket region for a boundary. Extremely expensive start from Wood, 20 from his first.
Two more! Good length delivery on middle and leg, Bavuma flicks but does not time it well. The ball goes towards deep mid-wicket and the batters make it back for a couple.
Length ball on middle, Bavuma tucks it to square leg.
Good length ball on middle, Bavuma flicks it to the deep mid-wicket region for a couple.
Full delivery on middle, de Kock flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.

SIX! Free Hit and in-form de Kock makes the most of it. Wood struggles again and ends up dishing another full toss around the body. This one is below the waist and the South African skipper gets under it. He smokes it over the fine leg fence for a biggie.
FREE HIT coming up!
NO BALL AND FOUR! Wood starts with a beamer bowled at 146 kph. It is around the body, de Kock manages to put bat on ball. He gets a bottom edge on it which goes fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Mark Wood to bowl now. He replaces Tom Curran after he was hammered for 15 runs in his only over.
Loopy delivery on middle, Bavuma looks to flick but it takes the leading edge and goes towards point. 9 from Moeen's second over.
Two byes! Flatter one outside off, Bavuma looks to cut but misses. Buttler too fails o collect the ball. The ball rolls towards third man and Bavuma steals two byes.

Half stop! Fullish outside off, Bavuma drives it towards cover where Morgan makes a half stop. The ball goes towards extra cover and before the fielders can stop the ball, the batters make it back for the second.
Top edge but safe! Floated ball on middle, Bavuma looks to sweep but it takes the top edge and goes towards fine leg. Luckily for him, it lands safely and the batters take a couple.
Full on middle, Quinton pushes it down to long on for a single.
Floated on the pads, de Kock works it to the deep mid-wicket region for a couple. The fielder throws it to the keeper but de Kock was well in.
Good length ball on the pads, de Kock flicks it to the deep square leg region for a single. 15 runs have come from the over.
SIX! This is excellent batting. 14 runs already in this over with one ball to go. Length ball on off, de Kock lunges and lifts it over the extra cover region for a biggie. First one of the game.
FOUR! This is hit with disdain though. Full delivery on off, de Kock hammers it through the mid on region for a boundary.
FOUR! Just over! Fullish delivery on middle, de Kock dances down the track and lifts it towards mid on. The mid on fielder jumps but the ball goes over him and into the fence.
Good length ball on middle, de Kock pushes it down to mid on.
Curran starts with a fuller one on off, de Kock drives it straight to mid off.
Tom Curran will bowl from the other end.
Flatter one outside off, Bavuma looks to punch but it takes the inside half of the bat and rolls back to Ali. Good start from Moeen. Only 4 runs from it.
Flighted on the pads, Quinton works it to the square leg region for a single.
Floated on middle, de Kock lunges forward and defends it back to the bowler.
Flatter one on the pads, Bavuma works it to the deep mid-wicket region for a single.
Loopy delivery on middle, de Kock pushes it down to long on for a single. De Kock is off the mark too.
South Africa are away!!! Ali starts with a flatter one on middle, Bavuma is underway by flicking this to deep mid-wicket for a single.

We are all set to begin!!! The England players make their way out to the middle followed by Quinton de Kock and Temba Bavuma. Moeen Ali will start with the ball for the visitors with Bavuma taking strike.
Both the teams are out there in the field for their respective National Anthems.

Quinton de Kock, the South African skipper says that it is going to be a good surface and they don't mind batting first. States that Dale Steyn is back and it is great to have him back. Goes onto say that Bavuma will open with him. Quinton says that he knows the value of an all-rounder and it is nice to have Dwaine Pretorius back. Finishes by saying that they will give it their best shot.

Eoin Morgan, the England skipper says that they will bowl first. Adds that it is a good wicket and they know exactly what they have to do. States that this T20 series holds a lot of context as there is a World Cup coming up. Goes onto say that Stokes, Wood and Buttler come back in which is great for them. Morgan says that they will need to assess the conditions as the match goes on.
England (Playing XI) - Jason Roy, Jos Buttler (WK), Jonny Bairstow, Eoin Morgan (C), Ben Stokes, Joe Denly, Moeen Ali, Tom Curran, Adil Rashid, Chris Jordan, Mark Wood.

South Africa (Playing XI) - Quinton de Kock (C/WK), Temba Bavuma, Rassie van der Dussen, JJ Smuts, David Miller, Dwaine Pretorius, Andile Phehlukwayo, Beuran Hendricks, Tabraiz Shamsi, Dale Steyn, Lungi Ngidi.
Toss - England have won the toss and they choose to bowl first.

Warm welcome everyone for the first T20I between South Africa and England in East London. Every match in this format holds great importance for both teams leading to the World Cup and we can expect the players from both sides to showcase their skill and talent to impress their captain and team management. The return of the likes of Jos Buttler, Ben Stokes and Dale Steyn will add extra star value to this contest and we're expecting a cracking encounter. Stay tuned for more...
